info.name: EGSA Instructor Project
info.description: Run top-to-bottom against a freshly seeded DB (npm run seed -- --reset). The collection walks the complete instructor cycle.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', d.refreshToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('instructorId', d.user._id);
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', d.refreshToken);
const c = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('cohortId', (c.find(x => x.name === 'SSF-01') || c[0])._id);
const s = pm.response.json().data.filter(x => x.status !== 'cancelled'); pm.collectionVariables.set('sessionId', (s.find(x => x.status === 'completed') || s[0])._id);

item.name: Published results — before publishing (must be empty for this student/assessment)

exec: pm.test('published result is visible', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d[0].score).to.eql(42); });
